decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed use of the ground floor as a children's nursery would be incompatible with the character of the St Stephen's Conservation Area, would result harm to the living conditions to the adjoining neighbours through noise and disturbance, and would result in the loss of a family house for which there is an identified need, contrary to Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) C.4.2 (Day Nurseries) and H.3.1 (Presumption Against Loss of Residential).

Condition : 2 - The application submitted fails to demonstrate that the proposed nursery would provide adequate facilities with regards to the Council's Baby and Child-care standards, and therefore fails to comply with adopted Unitary Development Plan policy C.4.2 (Day nurseries) and Part 6 - Baby and Childcare Facilities: Section 2.0 Nursery Provision of associated Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 3 - The proposed single-storey rear infill extension, by reason of its position and excessive depth, would represent an un-neighbourly development, which would harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers to the northeast, by reason of unreasonable enclosure, loss of light and loss of outlook, contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 4 - The proposal would fail to provide adequate parking arrangements in accordance with the Council's parking standards and would fail to provide safe separate pedestrian access for guardians dropping off and collecting children. The proposal is therefore likely to result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and the safe movement of pedestrians and vehicles in the area, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), C.4.2 (Day Nurseries) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for New Developments).
description: Change of use from residential to D1 (Nursery at ground floor level)
